card.text: Eta Carinae is the star inside the Homunculus Nebula, about 2,350 parsecs away.

sources.label: Smith (2006), ApJ 644, 1151
sources.locator: The Homunculus's shape and expansion give 2350 ± 50 pc

introduction.text: No surface is seen, only a wind that turns opaque at 9,400 K; its near-infrared glow fades to a tenth 6 au from the centre. An unseen companion circles it every 5.54 years.

sources.label: Weigelt et al. (2007), arXiv:astro-ph/0609715
